subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

Don't sound so **__excited__**.
solution:
The correct answer is **"eager."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Excited"** means feeling or showing enthusiasm and eagerness. (उत्साह और उत्सुकता महसूस करना या दिखाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *I am very **excited**__ for tomorrow.*
 
 
 
• **"Eager"** means having or showing keen interest or intense desire for something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति गहरी रुचि या तीव्र इच्छा होना या प्रदर्शित होना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The man was **eager**__ to please me.*
 
 
 
• Synonym of **excited** is **eager**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 -** casual**: Relaxed and unconcerned; not showing much interest or care. (निश्चिंत और बेपरवाह; ज्यादा दिलचस्पी या परवाह नहीं दिखाना)
 
• Option 2 - **composed**: Calm and in control of one's emotions; not easily agitated or disturbed. (शांत और अपनी भावनाओं पर नियंत्रण रखना; आसानी से उत्तेजित या परेशान नहीं होना)
 
• Option 4 - **tired**: Feeling or showing the need for sleep or rest; lacking in energy or enthusiasm. (नींद या आराम की आवश्यकता महसूस करना या दिखाना; ऊर्जा या उत्साह की कमी)
